description: The 5 programmes the agent reads in full. Each one covers a test scenario. Pages were chosen by hand from each programme's own website menu.

programmes.name: Data Engineering and Artificial Intelligence
programmes.why: Matches a CS graduate interested in AI and data engineering; clear requirements and deadlines.

programmes.name: Communications Engineering and Data Science
programmes.why: No 'AI' in the name, but tracks include machine learning and AI in networking; tests that tags find what names hide.

programmes.name: Intelligent Field Robotic Systems
programmes.why: Robotics (nearby field, fits Omar). Next intake's deadline is not published yet, and an old page shows a 2022 deadline: real missing and conflicting evidence.

programmes.name: International Master in Brain and Data Science
programmes.why: Entry rules say 'outstanding grades (roughly top 10% of your class)' and 'basic knowledge in general biology': cannot be checked from a CGPA alone.

programmes.name: International Law of Security, Peace and Sustainable Development
programmes.why: Requires 60 ECTS in law (or law, politics, international relations) and IELTS 7.0: a CS graduate is not eligible. Also used for the 'exclude law' preference.
